title: Degreewise stalk tensor comparison
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space, $x\in X$, and $T$ its module stalk functor [def-pc-module-stalk-functor]. Suppose a family of module isomorphisms $\varphi_{A,B}:T(A\otimes B)\cong T(A)\otimes T(B)$ is given for all sheaves of modules. For all cochain complexes $F,K$ [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] and integers $n$, there are isomorphisms $e_{F,K,n}:T(\operatorname{Tot}(F\otimes K)^n)\cong\operatorname{Tot}(TF\otimes TK)^n$ [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] such that for every $p+q=n$, $T(\iota_{p,q})e_{F,K,n}=\varphi_{F^p,K^q}\iota_{p,q}$, where $\iota$ denotes the relevant total-degree coproduct injection.

proof.text: Prove preservation of small colimits by the module stalk functor [def-pc-module-stalk-functor]. The source-library instance SheafOfModules.preservesColimitsOfShape_toSheaf (WeilConjectures.Mathlib.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.Presheaf.Sheafification) proves that forgetting to abelian sheaves preserves colimits. Mathlib TopCat.stalkSkyscraperSheafAdjunction makes the abelian-sheaf stalk functor a left adjoint, hence colimit-preserving. The composite with ModuleCat forget₂ to AddCommGrpCat is definitionally this composite. ModuleCat forget₂ reflects colimits, so preservesColimitsOfShape_of_reflects_of_preserves gives preservation by the module stalk functor. This is the private, completely proved lemma stalk_preserves_colimits.

For each n, the total tensor degree is definitionally the categorical coproduct indexed by the subtype of pairs (p,q) with ComplexShape.π (p,q) = n. Apply Mathlib PreservesCoproduct.iso to this coproduct, then Sigma.mapIso to the given component isomorphisms φ. This constructs the entire family e explicitly, with no choice from an unproved existence statement and no universe lifting or scalar-ring transport.

For the injection formula, unfold the chosen e and total-degree injections. PreservesCoproduct.inv_hom identifies the inverse comparison with sigmaComparison; cancel that isomorphism to identify the forward map with inv sigmaComparison. Then Mathlib map_ι_comp_inv_sigmaComparison followed by Sigma.ι_mapIso_hom gives exactly the required equality. The final identification with ιMapBifunctor is definitional.
